fields.name: gatedEvent

events.name: APPROVE
events.description: Signals that an approval request has been approved.

events.name: DENY
events.description: Opens the deny step for a request; the decision commits with the written reason.

events.name: OPEN_SUBJECT
events.description: A reviewer clicked View on a queue row. Hosts route subjectId to the subject record's own surface so the reviewer can read what they are approving. Scalars only — the row stays in the queue.
events.synonyms: view subject, open record, inspect request, see the article

events.name: CONFIRM_DENY

events.name: CANCEL_DENY
events.description: The deny form was dismissed without committing; the queue repaints.

events.name: CLOSE
events.description: Dismisses the review queue overlay.

events.name: ApprovalGranted
events.description: Signals that an approval process has been successfully completed; carries the held payload for the downstream listener to replay. Contract: if the replay fails (access denial, write failure), the host MUST emit APPROVAL_REPLAY_FAILED back so the request reopens.

events.name: ApprovalDenied
events.description: Indicates an approval request has been denied, with the reviewer's written reason.

events.name: ApprovalRequestLoaded
events.description: Indicates an approval request has been successfully loaded.

events.name: ApprovalRequestLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates failure to load an approval request.

events.name: ApprovalRequestReviewFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load or process an approval request for review.
events.synonyms: load error, failed review, processing failure

events.name: APPROVAL_REPLAY_FAILED
events.description: The host could not apply the granted action (access denial, failed write). The request reopens as pending so a decision is never silently lost.
events.synonyms: replay failed, apply failed, approval rollback

events.name: RUN_EXACT
events.description: Starts the ladder at the exact-check rung (R0). request is the whole DECIDE payload, carried down the chain so each rung can project its own inputs.

events.name: DECIDE
events.description: Public entry point — decide the candidate, falling through the ladder until a rung can prove the answer. accepted is R1's table; categories is R3's comparison set (R5's closed label set is the ClassifyRung categories knob, a design-time decision rather than a per-request one).

events.name: DECIDED
events.description: The ladder proved an answer. rung names which one served it: R0 exact, R1 table, R3 retrieved, R4 learned, R5 generative.

events.name: DECISION_FAILED
events.description: Even the generative floor (R5) could not answer — the classify service call itself failed.

knobDefs.label: Frame names
knobDefs.description: Atlas sub-texture names cycled into @entity.frameName, one per tick; empty disables name cycling.
knobDefs.synonyms: sprite names, atlas frames, animation frames

knobDefs.label: What should this app be called?
knobDefs.description: Name shown in the top-left of the chrome header.
knobDefs.synonyms: app title, product name, brand name, application name, site name

knobDefs.label: Content wrapper class
knobDefs.description: CSS class applied to the content area wrapper.

knobDefs.label: Content trait
knobDefs.description: Trait rendered inside the app layout content area

knobDefs.label: Current path
knobDefs.description: Nav-highlight ONLY: which nav item to mark active. This is NOT the page route — it does not change what page loads or where the orbital lives. To set the landing route or a page path, use the orbital's pagePath / page path, not this knob. When omitted, the layout reads the current route.
knobDefs.synonyms: active nav item, highlighted nav link, which menu item is selected, nav highlight

knobDefs.label: Detail slot
knobDefs.description: Slot where detail/edit views render

knobDefs.label: Where should navigation be placed?
knobDefs.description: sidebar = left rail; topnav = top bar; bottomnav = mobile tab bar; minimal = no nav.
knobDefs.synonyms: nav position, navigation style, menu placement, layout style

knobDefs.label: Layout pattern
knobDefs.description: UI pattern used to render the application chrome

knobDefs.label: Which sections appear in the sidebar?
knobDefs.description: Top-level navigation links shown on the left rail.
knobDefs.synonyms: nav links, menu items, sidebar sections, navigation entries, pages

knobDefs.label: Notification click event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when the user picks a notification

knobDefs.label: What notifications should appear?
knobDefs.description: Items shown in the notifications dropdown.
knobDefs.synonyms: alerts, messages, notices, notification items, bell items

knobDefs.label: Search event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when the user runs a global search

knobDefs.label: Sidebar trait
knobDefs.description: Optional trait rendered in the sidebar between the nav links and the footer — the Notion/Confluence-style always-visible page tree; scrolls independently. Unset renders plain nav only.
knobDefs.synonyms: sidebar tree, nav tree, page tree in sidebar, hierarchy rail

knobDefs.label: Theme
knobDefs.description: Data-theme attribute applied to the layout root (e.g. almadar-website-dark).

knobDefs.label: What shortcuts go in the top bar?
knobDefs.description: Icon buttons shown on the right side of the top bar (e.g. cart, help, profile).
knobDefs.synonyms: toolbar buttons, header actions, shortcut icons, quick actions

knobDefs.label: Signed-in avatar
knobDefs.description: Avatar image URL for the account menu.

knobDefs.label: Signed-in email
knobDefs.description: Email shown under the name in the account menu — typically @user.email.

knobDefs.label: Who is signed in
knobDefs.description: Display name of the signed-in viewer, shown in the app bar's account menu — typically @user.name. Blank renders no account menu, so people can see which account (and which persona) they are viewing the app as only when it is actually known.
knobDefs.synonyms: signed in user, current user, account, profile, persona, who am i

knobDefs.label: Idle content
knobDefs.description: The normal content view (e.g. the data ledger/browse trait) shown when no search is active.

knobDefs.label: Result row actions
knobDefs.description: Optional per-row actions on a result, e.g. { label: "View Details", event: "VIEW" }.

knobDefs.label: Result columns
knobDefs.description: Columns shown in the search-results grid; maps entity fields to display cells.

knobDefs.label: Results title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the search-results grid.

knobDefs.label: Search field
knobDefs.description: Entity field matched against the query (case-insensitive substring).

knobDefs.default: Tell the submitter why — the reason is recorded on the request.

knobDefs.label: Who can approve requests?
knobDefs.description: Roles eligible to decide. ENFORCED by the APPROVE/DENY transition guards: a viewer whose @user.role is not listed cannot fire a decision, from the button or from the bus. Empty = every signed-in viewer may decide (ungated).
knobDefs.synonyms: approver, reviewer, authorized roles, sign-off roles, who approves

knobDefs.label: Skip review queue for low-value requests?
knobDefs.description: When true, auto-approves requests below the threshold without queuing. v1.0 declarative only.
knobDefs.synonyms: auto approve, skip review, bypass queue, automatic approval

knobDefs.label: Block approving your own requests?
knobDefs.description: When on, a reviewer cannot APPROVE a request they submitted themselves (requestedBy = the viewer's id) — enforced by the APPROVE transition guard, from the button or from the bus. Requires hosts to stamp requestedBy at request creation. DENY stays allowed on your own request (denying your own request withdraws it). Off by default.
knobDefs.synonyms: self approval, self-approval, four eyes, four-eyes, separation of duties, cannot approve own, no self sign-off, dual control

knobDefs.label: Require approval
knobDefs.description: Require sign-off before a record is finalized. Off by default.
knobDefs.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, approval, needs approval, sign-off, signed off, review before, gatekeeper, editor approval, publishing approval, draft approval, content review, requires approval, manager approval, supervisor approval, admin approval, before going live

knobDefs.label: Escalate after how many hours pending?

knobDefs.label: Which field does the first load filter on?
knobDefs.description: Name the field the INITIAL load filters on, paired with initialFilterValue. This is the detail half of a list-detail pair: a thread that must wait for a conversation to be picked sets the field to its parent key and leaves the value blank, so the first load matches nothing and the empty state shows instead of every record in the table. REFETCH_FILTER then supplies the real selection. Left blank the first load is unfiltered, which is the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: initial filter, first load filter, wait for selection, detail pane filter, requires selection, start empty

knobDefs.label: What value does the first load filter for?
knobDefs.description: The value initialFilterField must equal on the first load. Blank is meaningful: it matches only records whose field is itself blank, which for a detail pane is normally none — that is how a thread stays empty until its parent is selected.
knobDefs.synonyms: initial filter value, first load value, default selection

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Header text shown above the calendar body.

knobDefs.label: Title binding
knobDefs.description: Per-row binding for the event title slot.

knobDefs.label: Week timeline body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for calendarLook='week-timeline' — events grouped by weekday in a 7-column timeline window.

knobDefs.label: Calendar id
knobDefs.description: Google calendar to sync with; blank = the service's default (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID env, else primary).
knobDefs.synonyms: google calendar id, target calendar

knobDefs.label: Description field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the description/notes; blank = none.
knobDefs.synonyms: notes field, details field

knobDefs.label: Duration field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the per-row duration in minutes (e.g. ClassSession.durationMinutes). Takes precedence over the fixed `durationMinutes` when set; ignored when `endField` is set. Field precedence: endField > durationField > durationMinutes — the corpus carries all these event shapes.
knobDefs.synonyms: minutes field, length field, per-row duration

knobDefs.label: Duration (minutes)
knobDefs.description: Fixed event length used when both `endField` and `durationField` are blank; the calendar service computes the timezone-correct end.
knobDefs.synonyms: length, event duration, minutes

knobDefs.label: Sync with Google Calendar
knobDefs.description: Push local records to Google Calendar and pull remote events into the CalendarEvent store. Off by default; needs the calendar service credentials (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SA_KEY).
knobDefs.synonyms: enable, calendar sync, google calendar, two-way sync, sync events, connect calendar

knobDefs.label: End field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO end. Blank = derive the end from `durationMinutes` instead (the corpus carries all four event shapes).
knobDefs.synonyms: end date field, finishes field

knobDefs.label: Location field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the location; blank = none.
knobDefs.synonyms: place field, venue field

knobDefs.label: Start field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the ISO start (dateTime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day).
knobDefs.synonyms: start date field, begins field, scheduledAt field

knobDefs.label: Entity to push
knobDefs.description: Event-shaped entity whose rows export to Google Calendar. MUST declare the marker columns `externalEventId : string = ""` and `syncedAt : number = 0` (stamped by the push loop). Defaults to the atom's own CalendarEvent store so the standalone validates; rebind per composition.
knobDefs.synonyms: entity to sync, source entity, record type, appointments entity, sessions entity

knobDefs.label: Title field
knobDefs.description: Target-entity field holding the event title.
knobDefs.synonyms: summary field, name field

knobDefs.label: Dependent entity
knobDefs.description: Entity holding rows that point at the parent (compose one cascade trait per dependent type). Defaults to the atom's own log so the standalone validates; rebind per composition.

knobDefs.label: Delete related records too
knobDefs.description: When a record is deleted, also delete the records that belong to it. Off by default.
knobDefs.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, cascade delete, delete children, on delete cascade, cascade on delete, remove related, soft delete cascade, dependent deletes, integrity cascade

knobDefs.label: Foreign-key field
knobDefs.description: Field on dependent rows that holds the parent's id.

knobDefs.label: Parent entity
knobDefs.description: Entity whose deletion triggers the cascade.

knobDefs.label: Grid Height
knobDefs.description: Grid row count clamping enemy movement bounds

knobDefs.label: Grid Width
knobDefs.description: Grid column count clamping enemy movement bounds

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the chase tick runs; toggle to freeze the mechanic

knobDefs.label: Initial Tiles
knobDefs.description: Seed grid tiles used for passability checks during movement

knobDefs.label: Initial Units
knobDefs.description: Seed units (players and enemies) present before the first tick

knobDefs.label: Choice Gates
knobDefs.description: One row per gate: id, gate center (x, y — y is the option-platform surface the judge tests against), the hint floated on a wrong answer, and the options: id, dx offset from the gate center, the label drawn above the platform, and correct. solved/chosen are stamped at runtime.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around an option platform's center when testing a landing (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around the gate's option plane when testing a landing (covers small hops onto the platform surface).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED judges option landings; toggle to freeze every gate as-is.

knobDefs.default: Service is healthy. All requests are being processed.
Circuit is open. Requests are being rejected to prevent cascading failures.
Testing recovery. Limited requests are being allowed through.

knobDefs.label: Cooldown (seconds)
knobDefs.description: Seconds the circuit stays open before transitioning to half-open and probing for recovery.
knobDefs.synonyms: reset timeout, open duration

knobDefs.label: Failure threshold
knobDefs.description: Number of consecutive failures before the circuit opens and starts rejecting requests.
knobDefs.synonyms: open trigger, failure count

knobDefs.label: Fallback behavior
knobDefs.description: What to return to callers while the circuit is open: reject = fail-fast/strict, cached-response = graceful degrade with stale data, queue = retry-later/no data loss, static-default = safe placeholder.
knobDefs.synonyms: open-state response, degraded mode, fail-fast vs graceful degrade

knobDefs.label: Half-open probe requests
knobDefs.description: Probe requests allowed through in the half-open state before deciding to close or re-open. Lower = cautious single-probe recovery; higher = aggressive parallel re-validation.
knobDefs.synonyms: probe count, recovery test size, probe aggressiveness, recovery test volume, cautious vs fast recovery

knobDefs.label: Coefficient Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per pad: id, center (x, y in world units), the mod applied to the road while inside x0..x1 (a scales slope+height, h shifts horizontally, k lifts), and the hint floated on apply, and hop (true = the board teleports the player onto the reshaped surface — use when the mod steps the road far from the pad; false = the skate snap carries the player, preserving speed). applied is stamped at runtime.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (approximates the body's half-width plus a step).

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers riding the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED applies touched pads; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

knobDefs.label: Show the log's own search box?
knobDefs.description: Embeds a search box above the activity feed. Set true only when the page has no other search affordance (e.g. no page-level std-search), so the surface shows one search box instead of two. False is the default — no consumer of this atom has ever had a search box.
knobDefs.synonyms: inline search, log search, built-in search, show search

knobDefs.label: Card look
knobDefs.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this atom.

knobDefs.label: How many entries per page should a pager show?
knobDefs.description: Page size a consumer-composed std-pagination control should use to compute total pages (e.g. from totalCount). This atom's own timeline pattern has no built-in pager UI, so this knob is informational for the composed control, not consumed by the timeline itself.
knobDefs.synonyms: visible rows, items per page, display limit

knobDefs.label: Which filters should appear above the feed?
knobDefs.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the timeline; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait, ANDed with the current kind tab. Empty (the default) = no filter bar — the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this atom and routes XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER, or relies solely on the built-in kind-filter chips (driven by kindOptions, which this knob does not duplicate or replace). Use this knob only for an extra facet beyond kind (e.g. actor, priority).
knobDefs.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

knobDefs.label: Backfill fields
knobDefs.description: Inputs shown in the form for manually logging missed events

knobDefs.label: Event kinds
knobDefs.description: Maps each event kind to its label, icon, and status color

knobDefs.label: How many entries per page when paging?
knobDefs.description: Records fetched from the server per REFETCH_PAGE request. The initial load and every search/kind/filter refetch stay unpaginated (load everything that matches) so the default unlimited activity feed is unchanged; only an explicit REFETCH_PAGE from a composed std-pagination control applies this limit.
knobDefs.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, page limit

knobDefs.label: Search box placeholder text
knobDefs.description: Hint text inside the log's search box.
knobDefs.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text

knobDefs.label: Export event

knobDefs.label: Show the gallery's own search box?

knobDefs.label: Which filters should appear above the gallery?

Use this knob only for a standalone gallery with no page-level filter affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

knobDefs.label: Image field

knobDefs.label: Name field

knobDefs.label: How many images to fetch per page?

knobDefs.label: Search box placeholder text

knobDefs.label: Wood Type

knobDefs.label: Yield Per Node

knobDefs.label: Default radius (km)

knobDefs.label: Node features

knobDefs.label: Aggregation

knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'count' / 'how many' -> count; 'total' / 'sum of' -> sum; 'average' / 'mean' -> avg; 'minimum' / 'lowest' -> min; 'maximum' / 'highest' -> max

knobDefs.label: Group / categorize / bucket / split by field
knobDefs.description: Entity field whose values become the chart's category buckets. Set this when the user voices 'group by X' / 'categorize by X' / 'bucket by X' / 'split by X' / 'break down by X' for any non-time field X (for time-units, set period + timeAxis=true instead).
knobDefs.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / categorize / breakdown by / split by / segment by. user phrases: 'group by status' -> categoryField=status; 'group by region' / 'by region' -> categoryField=region; 'group by category' / 'by category' -> categoryField=category; 'group by product' / 'by product' -> categoryField=product; 'group by month' / 'by month' -> categoryField=month (when explicitly requested as a category, not a time bucket); 'split by X' / 'break down by X' / 'segment by X' / 'bucket by X' -> categoryField=X

knobDefs.label: Chart type
knobDefs.description: Visual format for the rendered chart
knobDefs.synonyms: bar = vertical bars, line = connected line, pie = pie chart, donut = pie with hole, area = filled area chart, histogram = frequency distribution, scatter = XY scatter. user phrases: 'switch to donut' / 'make it a donut' / 'as a donut chart' -> donut; 'use a pie chart' -> pie; 'show as line' / 'line chart' -> line; 'as bars' / 'bar chart' -> bar

knobDefs.label: Drill event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when a user clicks a chart point
knobDefs.synonyms: click-through navigation event. user phrases: 'on click navigate to X' / 'drill into X' / 'when clicked open X' -> X event name

knobDefs.label: Chart height
knobDefs.description: Pixel height of the rendered chart
knobDefs.synonyms: vertical size in pixels. user phrases: 'taller' / 'make it taller' / 'increase height' / 'bigger vertically' -> larger number (e.g. 300, 400); 'shorter' / 'smaller' -> smaller; 'set height to 300' / '300px tall' -> 300

knobDefs.label: Top N
knobDefs.description: Keep only the first N points after sorting (0 = all)
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'top 5' -> 5; 'top 10' -> 10; 'first 3' -> 3; 'all' / 'no limit' -> 0; 'show all' -> 0

knobDefs.label: Group by month / quarter / week / day / year
knobDefs.description: Group by month, quarter, week, day, or year — the calendar bucket the chart groups data into. Set ALONGSIDE timeAxis=true whenever the user says 'group by <time-unit>' or 'by <time-unit>' or 'rebucket to <time-unit>' or 'instead of <other-time-unit>'.
knobDefs.synonyms: regroup / rebucket / change bucket / group differently. user phrases: 'group by month' / 'by month' / 'monthly' / 'monthly buckets' / 'switch to monthly' / 'instead of quarter' -> month; 'group by quarter' / 'by quarter' / 'quarterly' -> quarter; 'group by week' / 'by week' / 'weekly' / 'weekly buckets' -> week; 'group by day' / 'by day' / 'daily' / 'daily buckets' -> day; 'group by year' / 'by year' / 'yearly' / 'annually' -> year. Whenever the user voices 'group by <time-unit>' BOTH period AND timeAxis=true should be set.

knobDefs.label: Series
knobDefs.description: Pre-formatted multi-series spec for stacked or layered charts
knobDefs.synonyms: multiple lines / bars per category. user phrases: 'compare X and Y' -> add two series entries

knobDefs.label: Show legend
knobDefs.description: Display the series legend
knobDefs.synonyms: true shows the color key. user phrases: 'show legend' / 'show the legend' / 'show key' / 'with legend' / 'with a legend' -> true; 'hide legend' / 'no legend' / 'without legend' / 'remove legend' -> false

knobDefs.label: Show values
knobDefs.description: Render the numeric value on top of each data point
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'show values' / 'show numbers on bars' / 'with data labels' / 'label the bars' -> true; 'hide values' / 'no labels' -> false

knobDefs.label: Sort direction
knobDefs.description: Ascending or descending order for the sort field
knobDefs.synonyms: asc = ascending = lowest-to-highest = low-to-high = smallest-first. desc = descending = highest-to-lowest = high-to-low = largest-first. user phrases: 'highest to lowest' / 'largest first' / 'descending' -> desc; 'lowest to highest' / 'smallest first' / 'ascending' -> asc

knobDefs.label: Sort by
knobDefs.description: Order points by value, label, or leave unsorted
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'sort by value' / 'order by amount' -> value; 'sort alphabetically' / 'sort by name' -> label; 'no sort' / 'leave order' -> none

knobDefs.label: Stacking
knobDefs.description: Stack bars, normalize to 100%, or render side-by-side
knobDefs.synonyms: user phrases: 'side by side' / 'grouped' -> none; 'stacked' / 'stack the bars' -> stack; 'percent stacked' / '100% stacked' / 'normalized' -> normalize

knobDefs.label: Subtitle
knobDefs.description: Secondary line below the title
knobDefs.synonyms: secondary header below the title. user phrases: 'with subtitle X' / 'set subtitle to X' -> X

knobDefs.label: Time axis

knobDefs.synonyms: true means group by date / month / time. user phrases: 'group by month / week / year / date' -> set timeAxis=true; 'group by status / category' -> timeAxis=false

knobDefs.label: Date field

knobDefs.label: Title

knobDefs.label: Value field

knobDefs.label: Max credible-interval width

knobDefs.label: Prior alpha

knobDefs.label: Remediation ceiling
knobDefs.description: Posterior mean at or below this, with a tight interval, licenses REMEDIATION_NEEDED.

knobDefs.label: Posterior sample count
knobDefs.description: Number of Monte Carlo draws from the Beta posterior used to estimate the credible interval.

knobDefs.label: Sample rate
knobDefs.description: Fraction of examples to keep (1 = capture all). A prob/flip trial per observation.

knobDefs.label: Label sink

knobDefs.label: Reset Button Label

knobDefs.label: Width

knobDefs.label: Background Color

knobDefs.label: Clear Button Label
knobDefs.description: Label text for the button that clears the current selection.

knobDefs.label: Height

knobDefs.label: Highlight Color

knobDefs.label: Links

knobDefs.label: Parts
knobDefs.description: Roster of labeled parts (id, label, description, x, y, radius, color) the diagram renders as circles; the learner selects one to see its description.
knobDefs.synonyms: part, node, component, label, annotation

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the diagram.

knobDefs.label: Width
knobDefs.description: Canvas width in pixels.

knobDefs.label: Auto Drip
knobDefs.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset start the drip clock adding a small increment each interval; toggle live with the Auto-dose/Pause button.

knobDefs.label: Background Color
knobDefs.description: Canvas background color.

knobDefs.label: Bands
knobDefs.description: Ordered ascending roster of dose bands/zones — each carries the dose upper bound it covers, a label, a color, and whether crossing into it is terminal (irreversible; sets done true until Reset). The accumulated dose is classified into the first band whose upperBound it does not exceed, falling through to the last band beyond all bounds.
knobDefs.synonyms: zone, band, threshold, region, stage, phase, tier

knobDefs.label: Capacity
knobDefs.description: Maximum total dose the source can deliver; the source vessel drains to empty and additions clamp once accumulated dose reaches this cap.

knobDefs.label: Drip Interval (ms)
knobDefs.description: Milliseconds of running clock per auto-drip increment — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and adds a small step each time this interval elapses.

knobDefs.label: Dose History
knobDefs.description: Maximum points kept in the dose-history trace; older points drop off once exceeded.

knobDefs.label: Quantity Label
knobDefs.description: Label used for the accumulated-quantity readout and in the narration line.
knobDefs.synonyms: quantity, amount, dose, volume, level

knobDefs.label: Reservoir Label
knobDefs.description: Label for the vessel that fills as dose accumulates.
knobDefs.synonyms: reservoir, beaker, tank, container, receiving vessel

knobDefs.label: Show Canvas
knobDefs.description: When true (the default, standalone use) the instrument renders its own reservoir/source canvas and narration below the control strip. Set false when a domain sibling trait composes this atom via @rebindable and owns the accurate scene render itself — then only the control strip (add/drip/reset buttons) embeds via @trait.<name>, avoiding a duplicate canvas.

knobDefs.label: Source Color
knobDefs.description: Fill color for the source vessel.

knobDefs.label: Source Label
knobDefs.description: Label for the vessel that drains as dose is delivered from it.
knobDefs.synonyms: source, burette, supply, dispenser

knobDefs.label: Large Step
knobDefs.description: Quantity added per press of the coarse add button.

knobDefs.label: Small Step
knobDefs.description: Quantity added per press of the fine add button, and per auto-drip tick — for precise control near a band boundary.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the instrument.

knobDefs.label: Unit
knobDefs.description: Unit suffix appended to the step-size button labels (e.g. "mL", "mg", "units"); empty means no unit shown.

knobDefs.label: Zone Readout Label
knobDefs.description: Label used for the current-band readout row.

knobDefs.label: Close Band
knobDefs.description: Relative error at or below this fraction (but above the exact band) counts as close (partial points).

knobDefs.label: Exact Band
knobDefs.description: Relative error at or below this fraction counts as exact (full points).

knobDefs.label: Prompts
knobDefs.description: The question roster; each prompt carries the true numeric answer, an optional unit, and an optional hint. Realizations declare their own subject's quantities here.

knobDefs.label: Slider Default
knobDefs.description: Starting position of the estimate slider for each prompt.

knobDefs.label: Slider Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of the estimate slider.

knobDefs.label: Slider Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of the estimate slider.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the drill.

knobDefs.label: Band Cues
knobDefs.description: Per-band cues for ESTIMATE_JUDGED — one row per error band (exact/close/off); bands with no row spawn nothing.

knobDefs.label: Celebration Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned when a round completes (LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE / TRACE_DONE).

knobDefs.label: Correct Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a correct judged answer.

knobDefs.label: Progress Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a partial arrangement check (some but not all slots correct).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When false every cue arm is inert — visual feedback fully disabled without unmounting.

knobDefs.label: Streak Cue
knobDefs.description: Extra cue layered on the correct cue once the streak reaches the threshold.

knobDefs.label: Streak Threshold
knobDefs.description: Minimum ANSWER_JUDGED streak that adds the streak cue on top of the correct cue.

knobDefs.label: Verdict Cues
knobDefs.description: Per-verdict cues for CLASSIFY_UPDATED — one row per verdict string; verdicts with no row spawn nothing.

knobDefs.label: Wrong Cue
knobDefs.description: Cue spawned on a wrong judged answer (and an unmatched goal check).

knobDefs.label: Curve Kind
knobDefs.description: Curve family both curves are drawn from: power (y = A·xᴮ), linear (y = A + B·x), or sine (y = A·sin(B·x)).
knobDefs.synonyms: curve family, power law, linear function, sine wave, function type

knobDefs.default: Tune the two sliders until your curve matches the target curve, then press Check.
knobDefs.label: Goal Text
knobDefs.description: One-sentence statement of the inverse problem the learner must solve.

knobDefs.label: Parameter A Default
knobDefs.description: Starting value of the learner's first parameter.

knobDefs.label: Parameter A Label
knobDefs.description: Display label for the first parameter.

knobDefs.label: Parameter B Default
knobDefs.description: Starting value of the learner's second parameter.

knobDefs.label: Parameter B Label
knobDefs.description: Display label for the second parameter.

knobDefs.label: Show Live Distance
knobDefs.description: When true the RMS distance updates live as the learner tunes (warmer/colder); when false only attempts are shown, for a harder variant.

knobDefs.label: Target A
knobDefs.description: Hidden first parameter of the target curve the learner must recover.

knobDefs.label: Target B
knobDefs.description: Hidden second parameter of the target curve the learner must recover.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the canvas.

knobDefs.label: Tolerance
knobDefs.description: Maximum RMS distance between learner and target curves that still counts as a match.

knobDefs.label: Auto Run
knobDefs.description: Whether the evolution starts running immediately on load.

knobDefs.label: Decay
knobDefs.description: Diffusion rule only: fraction of a cell's value retained each generation.

knobDefs.label: Diffuse Rate
knobDefs.description: Diffusion rule only: how strongly a cell moves toward its neighbourhood average each generation.

knobDefs.label: Rule
knobDefs.description: The local update rule: life (Conway birth-3 survive-2-3), spread (an active 4-neighbour activates a cell), or diffusion (cells relax toward the neighbourhood average with decay).
knobDefs.synonyms: game of life, contagion, wavefront, heat diffusion, cellular automaton rule

knobDefs.label: Seeds
knobDefs.description: Flat cell indexes (row·cols + col) active at the start — the default plants a glider and a blinker. Realizations declare their own starting pattern here.

knobDefs.default: Tap cells to seed the world, then Run — or Step one generation at a time to see the rule at work.
knobDefs.label: Task Text
knobDefs.description: One-sentence statement of what to explore.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the grid.

knobDefs.label: Hit Ring Color
knobDefs.description: Color of the highlight ring drawn around the target once found.

knobDefs.label: Amplitude

knobDefs.label: Rate

knobDefs.label: Bin Count
knobDefs.description: Number of histogram buckets across the 0..1 value range.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the canvas.

knobDefs.label: Elements
knobDefs.description: Roster of toggleable elements; each carries its label, its weight toward the derived total, its default enabled state, and its canvas position.
knobDefs.synonyms: element, node, component, module, factor, contributor

knobDefs.label: Height
knobDefs.description: Canvas height in pixels.

knobDefs.label: Links
knobDefs.description: Declared relationships drawn between elements; a link dims when either endpoint is disabled.
knobDefs.synonyms: link, edge, connection, dependency, relationship

knobDefs.label: Outcome Label
knobDefs.description: Label prefix used in the readout describing the derived total and hold status.

knobDefs.label: Threshold
knobDefs.description: The summed weight of enabled elements must reach this value for the system to hold.

knobDefs.label: Title
knobDefs.description: Title shown above the instrument.

knobDefs.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED start the tick auto-adding points up to Max Points; toggle live with the Run/Pause button.

knobDefs.label: X Axis Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates; also the x endpoint the fit/guess lines are drawn to.

knobDefs.label: X Axis Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates.

knobDefs.label: Y Axis Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of the canvas y axis; also the ceiling curve samples clamp to and the high end of the guess-intercept slider default range.

knobDefs.label: Y Axis Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of the canvas y axis; also the floor curve samples clamp to and the low end of the guess-intercept slider default range.

knobDefs.label: Fit Curve Label
knobDefs.description: Legend label for the computed least-squares fit line.

knobDefs.label: Grid Step
knobDefs.description: Spacing between canvas gridlines, in data coordinates.

knobDefs.label: Guess Intercept Caption
knobDefs.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-intercept value above its slider.

knobDefs.label: Guess Intercept Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMax.

knobDefs.label: Guess Intercept Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMin.

knobDefs.label: Guess Curve Label
knobDefs.description: Legend label for the learner's proposed line, shown while guessMode is on and the fit isn't yet revealed.

knobDefs.description: When true the learner's guessed line is shown instead of the fit until Reveal Fit, and the guess is scored against least squares.

knobDefs.label: Guess Slope Caption
knobDefs.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-slope value above its slider.

knobDefs.label: Guess Slope Max
knobDefs.description: Upper bound of the guess-slope slider.

knobDefs.label: Guess Slope Min
knobDefs.description: Lower bound of the guess-slope slider.

knobDefs.label: Initial Points
knobDefs.description: Scatter points the canvas starts with, in axis data coordinates; Reset reseeds from this roster.
knobDefs.synonyms: seed points, dataset, scatter data, sample

knobDefs.label: Interactive
knobDefs.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas — required for dragging points.

knobDefs.label: Max Points
knobDefs.description: Cap on accumulated scatter points; Add Point and the auto-run tick stop once reached, until Reset.

knobDefs.label: Added Narration Template
knobDefs.description: Narration phrase after a point is added (button or tick), assembled as "<template> <n> — r = .., R² = ..".

knobDefs.description: Narration phrase after Reveal Fit, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = .. — guess score <score>%".

knobDefs.label: Guess Updated Narration Template
knobDefs.description: Narration phrase after a guess slider moves, assembled as "<template> <score>%".

knobDefs.label: Loaded Narration Template
knobDefs.description: Narration phrase after INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset load the seed points, assembled as "<n> <template> — r = .., R² = ..".

knobDefs.label: Max Reached Narration Suffix
knobDefs.description: Suffix appended to the added-point narration once maxPoints is hit.

knobDefs.label: Moved Narration Template
knobDefs.description: Narration phrase after a point is dragged, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = ..".

knobDefs.label: Guard comparison
knobDefs.description: How to gate dispatch. `eq` (default) does string-equality via `triggerStatus` against the upstream event's `status` field, exactly as before. `gt`/`lt`/`gte`/`lte` instead numerically compare `guardField` (read from the event's `data` payload) against `guardValue` — e.g. fire only when a stock level drops below a threshold.
knobDefs.synonyms: comparison operator, threshold operator, guard mode, trigger comparison, numeric gate, greater than, less than, threshold crossing

knobDefs.label: Guard value (numeric)
knobDefs.description: Threshold compared against `guardField` when `guardOp` is not `eq` (e.g. fire when stock drops below 5).
knobDefs.synonyms: threshold, cutoff, limit, watermark, trigger value

knobDefs.label: Trigger events
knobDefs.description: Event names that should fire a notification. Set this to the upstream event name (e.g. OrderPlaced, CheckoutCompleted) so this atom listens for events from the orbital that emits them. The orbital owning this trait reacts whenever the named event fires anywhere in the schema.
knobDefs.synonyms: subscribe to event, listen for event, react to event, watch for, wire upstream event, observe event from another orbital, cross-orbital subscription, on-event trigger

knobDefs.label: Channel
knobDefs.description: Delivery channel. `in-app` (default) emits the in-app `notify` toast. `email`/`sms`/`webhook` dispatch through call-service at event time (email.send / twilio.sendSMS / webhook.send) and persist a NotificationRecord audit row with an honest `dispatched` flag: true only once the service call succeeds, false plus the failure detail in `error` otherwise. `push` looks up the recipient's PushSubscription row (captured by std-notification-center's subscribe flow) and dispatches web-push via push.send — a recipient with no subscription records the audit row undispatched (`no-push-subscription`). `webhook` requires `webhookUrl` to actually dispatch; a blank `webhookUrl` still records the audit row undispatched rather than failing. A per-user NotificationPreference row with a non-blank `channel` overrides this value for that recipient.
knobDefs.synonyms: delivery method, notification channel, send via, dispatch through, push notification, web push

knobDefs.label: Push deep link
knobDefs.description: In-app path opened when the recipient clicks the push notification (e.g. '/orders'). Blank = the app root.
knobDefs.synonyms: click url, open on click, target path, notification link

knobDefs.label: Push icon
knobDefs.description: Icon URL shown on the push notification. Blank = the browser default.
knobDefs.synonyms: notification icon, badge image

knobDefs.label: Push title
knobDefs.description: Notification title for the push channel. Falls back to `template` when blank. Ignored for other channels.
knobDefs.synonyms: notification title, push heading, alert title

knobDefs.label: Quiet hours end
knobDefs.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window closes. Equal to `quietStartHour` = disabled.
knobDefs.synonyms: do not disturb until, silence end, night mode end

knobDefs.label: Quiet hours start
knobDefs.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the atom-level quiet window opens. Equal to `quietEndHour` = disabled. Dispatches inside the window persist an audit row (`error: quiet-hours`, dispatched:false) which std-notification-center's digest cycle drains later. Per-user quiet hours from NotificationPreference rows apply in addition.
knobDefs.synonyms: quiet hours, do not disturb from, silence start, night mode start

knobDefs.label: Recipients
knobDefs.description: Recipient ids/addresses. v1.1 uses the first entry; multi-recipient fan-out lands in v1.2 (gap). When empty, falls back to `fallbackRecipient` if set, otherwise the authenticated user.
knobDefs.synonyms: targets, addressees, notify to

knobDefs.label: Severity
knobDefs.description: info, success, warning, or error — controls styling
knobDefs.synonyms: alert level, priority, urgency

knobDefs.label: Suppression list
knobDefs.description: Recipient ids/addresses to skip (e.g. unsubscribed users). Suppression check runs before dispatch.
knobDefs.synonyms: block list, unsubscribed, opt-out list

knobDefs.label: Message template
knobDefs.description: Text shown to the recipient; supports payload interpolation
knobDefs.synonyms: notification text, message body, alert text

knobDefs.label: Trigger status
knobDefs.description: When `guardOp` is `eq` and this is set, dispatch only when the upstream event's `status` field equals this value (e.g. fire only when a record becomes 'approved'). Empty = fire on every subscribed event. Ignored when `guardOp` is a numeric comparison.
knobDefs.synonyms: on status, when status, status filter, only when, fire on, react on status

knobDefs.label: Webhook secret
knobDefs.description: Signing secret forwarded to the webhook service so the receiving endpoint can verify the payload. Ignored when `webhookUrl` is blank.
knobDefs.synonyms: signing secret, hmac secret, webhook signature, shared secret

knobDefs.label: Webhook URL
knobDefs.description: Destination endpoint for the webhook channel. Dispatch only fires when this is non-blank; a blank URL on channel "webhook" records the audit row with dispatched:false instead of crashing (a consumer misconfiguration, not a failure).
knobDefs.synonyms: webhook endpoint, callback url, target url, http endpoint, notify url

knobDefs.label: Tiles
knobDefs.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)

knobDefs.label: Initial Units
knobDefs.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs

knobDefs.label: Features
knobDefs.description: Board features — collectible targets (matched by targetType) plus decorations

knobDefs.label: Points Per Target
knobDefs.description: Score awarded per objective reached

knobDefs.label: Remove On Reach
knobDefs.description: When true the target model is removed once reached (collect); when false it is flagged done and stays (visit/deliver)

knobDefs.label: Target Type
knobDefs.description: Feature type counted as a collectible objective

knobDefs.label: Extra Stats
knobDefs.description: Board-specific HUD stats appended after the standard set.

knobDefs.label: Fx Presets
knobDefs.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark.

knobDefs.label: Objective Label
knobDefs.description: HUD label for the remaining-objective counter.

knobDefs.label: Score Label
knobDefs.description: HUD label for the score/progress counter (e.g. Deliveries counting up).

knobDefs.label: Target Type
knobDefs.description: Feature type counted as a collectible objective

knobDefs.label: Pads
knobDefs.description: One row per floor pad: id, center (x, y in world units), and grp (0 = ungrouped, always live; N = live only while it is the lowest uncompleted group). lit is stamped at runtime.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a pad's center when testing player contact (covers skating over the surface the pad sits on).

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED lights touched live pads and reports group/set completion; toggle to freeze every pad as-is.

knobDefs.label: Page-change event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when the user picks a new page

knobDefs.label: Page size
knobDefs.description: Rows per page used to derive total page count

knobDefs.label: Customers
knobDefs.description: Seed roster of stationary customers, each with their own position + patience/maxPatience

knobDefs.label: Hit Radius
knobDefs.description: Per-axis distance (world units) within which a patrol counts as touching the player; smaller values demand precise contact, larger values forgive.

knobDefs.label: Patrols
knobDefs.description: One row per patroller: id, the [x0, x1] beat it walks, its base y, its speed in units/s, and optionally waveAmp/wavePeriod for a vertical sine bob (waveAmp 0 = flat ping-pong). Current x/dir/t/cy/touching/hit are stamped at runtime.

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn X
knobDefs.description: Player x assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives (match the body authority's spawn).

knobDefs.label: Player Spawn Y
knobDefs.description: Player y assumed before the first BODY_MOVED arrives.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms tick moves patrols and tests contact; toggle to freeze every patrol in place.

knobDefs.label: Features
knobDefs.description: One row per collectible: id, center (x, y in world units), board-defined kind (star, boost, …), display glyph and message floated on pickup. collected is stamped at runtime.

knobDefs.label: Reach X
knobDefs.description: Horizontal tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact.

knobDefs.label: Reach Y
knobDefs.description: Vertical tolerance (world units) around a feature's center when testing player contact; generous values catch fly-through pickups.

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true, BODY_MOVED collects touched features; toggle to freeze the set as-is.

knobDefs.label: Curve Mods Enabled
knobDefs.description: When true, entity.curveMods reshape the skate surface inside each mod's x-range: the road samples the base curve at (x − h) and applies a·y + k (slope scales by a) — coefficient pads lift/tilt the segment the player is riding. Multiple overlapping mods stack by summing each mod's delta from the base surface; a mod whose shifted sample leaves the curve range is skipped. Default off: boards without coef pads pay nothing.

knobDefs.label: Drift Regions
knobDefs.description: Axis-aligned rects (x0..x1, y0..y1 in world units) each carrying a constant acceleration (ax, ay in units/s²) applied with the physics dt whenever the body's center is inside — winds, currents, gradient pushes. Empty list = zero behavior change.

knobDefs.label: Gravity
knobDefs.description: Units/s² added to vertical velocity; the SIGN is the vertical convention — positive pulls toward +y (screen boards, y down), negative toward −y (math canvases, y up) — and jumps always fire against it

knobDefs.label: Jump Strength
knobDefs.description: Vertical speed in units/s imparted by JUMP, directed against gravity; apex height ≈ jumpStrength² / (2·|gravity|)

knobDefs.label: Kill Y
knobDefs.description: Fall line: crossing it in the gravity direction fires BODY_FELL once (past it downward on y-down boards, below it on y-up canvases); y-up consumers must set a value below their world floor

knobDefs.label: Max Fall Speed
knobDefs.description: Terminal velocity cap in units/s applied to vertical speed each tick

knobDefs.label: Move Speed
knobDefs.description: Horizontal run speed in units/s applied by STEER dir ±1

knobDefs.label: Platforms
knobDefs.description: Level geometry as min-corner rects: ground/platform tiles are solid one-way landing surfaces, hazard tiles emit BODY_HAZARD on touch, goal tiles emit BODY_GOAL

knobDefs.label: Running
knobDefs.description: When true the 33ms physics tick integrates and collides; toggle to freeze the body

knobDefs.label: Curve Skating
knobDefs.description: When true, a grounded body within skateSnap of the skateCurve surface rides the curve: y snaps to the interpolated surface and tangential gravity (g·slope/(1+slope²)) accelerates vx, so the body slides downhill along the graph and launches off its ends; JUMP kicks free. Engages when grounded, when landing on a tile, or when a falling (not rising) body passes within skateSnap above the surface.

knobDefs.label: Skate Curve
knobDefs.description: Surface samples (x strictly increasing) the body skates when skate is on; y is the surface height for the body's MIN corner, linearly interpolated between bracketing samples — mirror the render-side curve so what you see is what you ride

knobDefs.label: Skate Max Gap
knobDefs.description: Largest x-gap between consecutive skateCurve samples that still counts as surface. 0 = unlimited (sparse two-sample lines skate fine). Dense resampled curves with real gaps between segments (stitched worlds) MUST set this — otherwise the sampler invents a skatable chord across every gap (an invisible line above the bridge/terrain that the body snaps to and glides along).

knobDefs.label: Skate Snap
knobDefs.description: Max vertical gap (world units) between the body's min corner and the curve surface for skating to engage or stay engaged; larger values grab earlier on landing, smaller values release sooner on bumps

knobDefs.label: Spawn Body
knobDefs.description: Initial body rect (min-corner x/y plus width/height) seeded on INIT/RESTART; width/height also define the collision box

knobDefs.label: Right Wall
knobDefs.description: Largest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.label: Left Wall
knobDefs.description: Smallest x the body's min corner may hold (world bounds, not level geometry)

knobDefs.default: Rate limit exceeded. Requests are being throttled.

knobDefs.description: Requests allowed to burst above the per-minute rate before steady-state throttling kicks in. Lower burst = strict/no-spikes; higher burst = forgiving/allow-spikes.

knobDefs.label: Enabled
knobDefs.description: Whether rate limiting is active for the host orbital. Off by default; turn on to throttle requests.
knobDefs.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, rate limit, throttle, requests per minute, slow down, cap usage, request cap, limit traffic, prevent abuse

knobDefs.label: Rate-limit key strategy
knobDefs.description: What identifier the per-bucket counter is keyed on: source IP, authenticated user, API key, or one global bucket.
knobDefs.synonyms: limiter key, bucket key

knobDefs.label: Override roles

knobDefs.label: Requests per minute

knobDefs.label: Max stars
knobDefs.description: Top of the rating scale (typically 5)

knobDefs.label: Submit event
knobDefs.description: Event emitted when the user submits the form

knobDefs.label: Submit button
knobDefs.description: Label on the primary submit button

knobDefs.label: Form title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the review compose form

knobDefs.label: What actions can users take on this record?
knobDefs.description: Buttons on the panel header. One primary at most; the rest collapse past maxInlineActions.
knobDefs.synonyms: record actions, detail actions, panel buttons

knobDefs.label: Allow editing the document?
knobDefs.description: When false the document look is a pure read surface: no header Edit button, no click-to-edit body, no click-to-rename title. Hosts pass a role condition here so read-only viewers get the page without its authoring affordances; the entity's own access predicates stay the enforcement floor.
knobDefs.synonyms: read only document, viewer mode, can edit, editing allowed

knobDefs.label: Autosave hint
knobDefs.description: Muted caption next to the Done button telling the author their work persists on its own.

knobDefs.label: Body content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = panel (the default). See slideOverBodyContent/pageBodyContent for the other looks; any may be overridden directly while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

knobDefs.label: Which field holds the document body?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record that carries the rich-text HTML body the document look renders and edits (e.g. content, body, articleText).
knobDefs.synonyms: body field, content field, document field

knobDefs.label: Which field is the cover image?
knobDefs.description: Name of the image-typed field on the loaded record painted as the document look's full-bleed hero banner (e.g. coverImage, heroImage). Empty = no banner, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: cover field, hero image field, banner field

knobDefs.label: Detail look
knobDefs.description: Visual treatment for the record surface. panel = an inline detail-panel in the page flow (bodyContent); slide-over = the same panel as a right-hand drawer over the list behind it (slideOverBodyContent); page = a full-width record page with roomier spacing (pageBodyContent); document = a wiki-page/note/article surface — big editable title over a rich-text body, no labelled field rows, click-to-edit with autosave (documentBodyContent / documentEditingContent). Selecting a look swaps which body tree renders after the record loads; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail style, drawer, slide over, full page, document, wiki page, note, article

knobDefs.label: Document look body (reading)
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document while reading: the pure writing surface — editable title with the rich-text body DIRECTLY beneath it, Edit and the actions menu tucked into the header corner. Metadata never sits between title and content; compose the sibling RecordItemDetails trait beside this one for the settings rail. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data, because it is also painted by arms whose payload is not the record.

knobDefs.label: Document look body (editing)
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr for detailLook = document during an editing session: the same surface with the body live and the header corner showing the autosave hint + Done. Binds only @entity fields, never ?data.

knobDefs.label: Done button label
knobDefs.description: Label of the button that ends the document editing session; work is already autosaved when it is pressed.

knobDefs.label: Edit button label
knobDefs.description: Label of the quiet button above the document body that starts an editing session (the body itself is also clickable).

knobDefs.label: Which fields appear in the record panel?
knobDefs.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a labelled row in the panel. Unlike a list row, a detail panel SHOULD label every field — the value stands alone here with no column header or repeated row position to name it.
knobDefs.synonyms: detail fields, record fields, panel fields, shown fields

knobDefs.label: Which field is the document icon?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record whose icon name renders beside the document title (e.g. icon). Empty = no icon, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: icon field, glyph field

knobDefs.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
knobDefs.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch, so panel fields can use dot-paths like owner.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields

knobDefs.label: How many actions before collapsing?
knobDefs.description: Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu.
knobDefs.synonyms: inline actions limit, overflow threshold

knobDefs.label: When does this surface load?
knobDefs.description: init = a routed detail page; the record loads as soon as the page mounts (the default). event = an overlay that stays blank until a row-click OPEN_VIEW hands it an id, which is what a list-embedded slide-over needs — mounting an init-loading surface on a list page would fetch a record it has no id for.
knobDefs.synonyms: open on click, slide over, row click, blank until opened, list embedded

knobDefs.label: Page look body
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = page: a full record page, width-capped so field rows do not stretch past a readable measure (Almadar_UI_Beauty.md §3).

knobDefs.label: Placeholder text
knobDefs.description: Placeholder shown in the document body when it is empty.

knobDefs.label: How should the fields be grouped?
knobDefs.description: Optional titled groups over `fields`, e.g. [{title: Contact, fields: [email, phone]}]. Group into sections of 3-5 once a record carries more than about seven fields — a flat list past that is the cognitive-load problem Almadar_UX.md §1.4 (Miller) describes. Empty = one ungrouped list, the default.
knobDefs.synonyms: field groups, grouped fields, panel sections, fieldsets

knobDefs.label: Show the action buttons?
knobDefs.description: Set false for a read-only record view; a panel with actions nothing listens to is a dead affordance.
knobDefs.synonyms: read only, hide actions, view only

knobDefs.label: Slide-over look body
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the record loads when detailLook = slide-over: the same panel as a right-hand drawer, so the list behind stays in place. Use when the record is a glance, not a workspace.

knobDefs.label: Which field is the subtitle?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field shown under the title (e.g. company, category). Set to "" for no subtitle at all — the right choice for the document look, whose metadata lives in the properties strip, not a second line.
knobDefs.synonyms: subtitle field, secondary field, subheading, no subtitle

knobDefs.label: Which field is the record's title?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the loaded record shown as the panel title (e.g. contactName, subject, title).
knobDefs.synonyms: title field, heading field, name field, label field

knobDefs.label: Details drawer content tree
knobDefs.description: Render-ui SExpr painted into the drawer slot on OPEN_DETAILS; binds the row stashed by SHOW_DETAILS. Info-only by default — no metaCommitEvent, so every row displays rather than edits (editing rides the document's actions menu). Override at the call site to extend the panel or to opt into in-place commits via metaCommitEvent: META_CHANGE.

knobDefs.label: Details drawer heading
knobDefs.description: Heading of the settings card (e.g. Details, Page info, Document settings).

knobDefs.label: Which metadata properties appear in the details drawer?
knobDefs.description: The record's metadata shown as read-only INFO in the details drawer (Updated, address, status, …). Editing metadata is a normal action under the document's menu, not an inline affordance here.
knobDefs.synonyms: properties, metadata fields, document info, page info, front matter

knobDefs.label: Rule fields
knobDefs.description: Inputs shown in the recurrence-rule definition form

knobDefs.label: Section title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the recurrence editor

knobDefs.label: Which field labels each related row?
knobDefs.description: Name of the field on the (rebound) related row rendered as the row label and carried as SELECT_RELATED's name — set it to `title` (etc.) whenever the bound entity labels rows differently. The rows are mapped through this at render time, because a trait-level `fields {}` rename is declaration-only on the runtime path and every populated row used to render a blank label.

knobDefs.label: Relation field
knobDefs.description: RelatedItem field compared against SHOW_RELATED's key to scope the fetch to one parent document; empty renders the full unfiltered collection (default).

knobDefs.label: Section title
knobDefs.description: Heading shown above the related list.

Safe to page: this atom's selection is a single transient id (never an accumulated array), so no already-picked item can be stranded on another page.
knobDefs.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, page limit

knobDefs.label: Bone
knobDefs.description: Skeleton bone name. A named group is addressable by a `draw-mesh` `skin` block (smooth skinning): the skinned mesh deforms with this group's animated transform. Names resolve within the nearest enclosing `skeleton: true` group (falling back to the canvas), so multiple instances of one rig never collide. Distinct from `id` (the hit-test handle).

knobDefs.label: Clip
knobDefs.description: Clip the group's items to an SVG path (`d` syntax) in world units relative to the group origin — masked reveals, meters, portraits.

knobDefs.description: 0..1 opacity.

knobDefs.label: Position
knobDefs.description: Logical scene position; the projector maps it to pixels / world.

knobDefs.label: Rotate
knobDefs.description: Rotation in radians (painter units).

knobDefs.label: Rotation
knobDefs.description: Euler rotation `[x, y, z]` in radians (world axes) — per-axis joint rotation for the 3D backend; a group placed at a joint with children authored joint-local IS a bone. The 2D painter applies only the in-plane `z` component, after `rotate`.

knobDefs.label: Scale
knobDefs.description: Uniform scale applied to the whole group.

knobDefs.label: Skeleton
knobDefs.description: Marks this group as a skeleton SCOPE: `bone` names and `skin` bindings in its subtree resolve against each other only — one scope per rig instance.

knobDefs.label: Animation

knobDefs.label: Position
knobDefs.description: Logical scene position; `z` is height in cells (projected to world Y).
